rolesAndResponsibilities: Design and implement scalable, performant, and maintainable chat and agent user interfaces using React 19, TypeScript, PrimeReact, and Relativity’s internal design systems. Build rich AI-powered chat experiences, including streaming responses, conversational state management, tool and skill interactions, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Apply frontend modularization practices through clean module boundaries, shared libraries, code splitting, and Nx monorepo development. Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across frontend-focused initiatives. Explore and integrate AI-driven enhancements into customer-facing and internal experiences.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Définir et piloter l'architecture technique de la refonte des interfaces homme-machine (IHM) des Postes de Commandes Centralisées, en migrant des applications client lourd C++ vers une solution client léger React. Recueillir et analyser les besoins auprès des équipes de développement et des équipes métier, en les traduisant en exigences techniques claires et actionnables. Concevoir et développer une architecture front-end robuste et maintenable, en assurant la cohérence avec les systèmes existants en C++. Définir les standards, les bonnes pratiques et les guidelines de développement React à l'échelle du département. Assurer la cohérence technique entre les composants existants en C++ et les nouvelles interfaces React, notamment en matière d'APIs, d'échanges de données et d'interopérabilité. Participer activement aux revues de code et de conception, garantissant ainsi la qualité et la performance des livrables. Contribuer à l'élaboration de la feuille de route technique et à la planification des différentes phases de migration.

skillsRequired: 5-7 years of professional software engineering in an agile environment, delivering secure, scalable services.
Understands high-level LLM concepts (e.g., hallucinations, prompt sensitivity) and safe vs. unsafe AI use cases.
Experienced in using AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and prototyping, with critical review of outputs.
Skilled in prompt engineering—designing reusable prompts and coaching peers.
Familiar with ethical/cost risks (bias, privacy, vendor lock-in) and embeds basic compliance checks into workflows.
Proficient in Node.js/TypeScript for RESTful APIs (OpenAPI), and hands-on AWS serverless patterns.
Comfortable with infrastructure as code (CDK/Terraform), containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools.
Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases; able to design and optimize schemas for performance.
Applies security best practices in code and deployments (e.g., IAM, secrets management) and reviews AI-assisted suggestions for safety.
Strong communication of technical and AI-related concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to mentor or guide peers on engineering best practices and AI-augmented workflows.
Strong proficiency in React for building modern, component-based web interfaces.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Design and build cloud-native web applications using React/TypeScript and Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask) on Azure or GCP; collaborate with team members and clients to understand requirements; build responsive, accessible web applications; design and implement APIs and back-end services; translate designs into high-quality maintainable code; deploy and operate workloads on Azure/GCP including containerized services; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability; use AI coding assistants effectively; work with Git and disciplined branching strategy; apply architecture and design patterns for scalability; participate in daily scrums, shape and implement user stories, write tests, review pull requests.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Build & Ship: Design, implement, and maintain frontend features across the PaymentIQ platform — checkout, hosted fields, and back-office — with a focus on clean, maintainable code. Architecture & Direction: Shape the technical direction of our frontend stack, drive component reuse and consistency, and help evolve the architecture as the product grows. End-to-End Ownership: Take features from design through production and beyond — including monitoring, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement. Quality First: Contribute to code reviews, and help raise the bar for engineering quality, performance, and accessibility across the team. Mentorship: Coach more junior engineers, share knowledge, and lift the overall skill level of the frontend team. Collaboration: Work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate merchant needs into solid, user-friendly solutions.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Design, develop, and enhance the ARIS Flows UI — an advanced visual flow builder; implement innovative UI components for canvas interactions, trigger configuration, and flow step authoring; build AI-assisted authoring experiences where LLM-generated suggestions, flow previews, and contextual recommendations meet the user; apply AI-assisted development practices throughout the full software lifecycle using tools like Claude Code for component generation, automated testing, accessibility review, and localization; support the entire product lifecycle from requirements analysis to testing and cloud deployment; work in an Agile software development process in international, cross-site teams; collaborate closely with UX experts to translate designs into pixel-accurate, accessible, high-performance React components; enhance and maintain existing products; monitor/triage customer issues, troubleshoot and resolve defects.
